title: Fort Kyk-Over-Al
description: The Dutch build a fort at the junction of three rivers, the first permanent European settlement in what becomes Guyana.

title: Berbice slave rebellion
description: Enslaved people under Cuffy seize most of Berbice for over a year, one of the first large slave revolts in the Americas.

title: Colonies pass to Britain
description: The Netherlands cedes Demerara, Essequibo and Berbice to Britain under the Convention of London.

title: East Coast Demerara rebellion
description: Over ten thousand enslaved people rise against the planters; their defeat and the death of the missionary John Smith stir the abolition movement.

title: British Guiana formed
description: The crown unites Demerara-Essequibo and Berbice into the single colony of British Guiana.

title: First East Indians arrive
description: Nearly four hundred indentured labourers from India disembark, the start of the migration that reshapes the population.

title: Boundary award
description: An international tribunal fixes the boundary with Venezuela along the Schomburgk Line, a decision Venezuela later rejects and the dispute over the Essequibo revives.

title: Enmore martyrs
description: Police shoot five striking sugar workers dead, an event that feeds the independence movement.

title: PPP founded
description: Cheddi Jagan and Forbes Burnham found the People's Progressive Party, the colony's first mass party.

title: Constitution suspended
description: Six months after the PPP's first election win, Britain suspends the constitution and lands troops, removing Jagan's government.

title: PPP splits
description: Burnham breaks from Jagan, beginning the bitter political rivalry that divides the country for decades.

title: Burnham comes to power
description: Under a new proportional system, Burnham forms a coalition that takes office and leads the country to independence.

title: Independence
description: British Guiana becomes the independent state of Guyana.

title: Rupununi uprising
description: Ranch owners and their militia seize four towns in the Rupununi and declare a short-lived separatist government.

title: Co-operative Republic
description: Guyana becomes a republic within the Commonwealth on the anniversary of the Berbice rising.

title: Jonestown
description: More than nine hundred members of the American Peoples Temple sect die by killing and suicide in their jungle commune.

title: Burnham president under new constitution
description: A new constitution makes Burnham executive president, formalising his personal rule.

title: Free elections return
description: The first internationally recognised free elections since 1964 bring Cheddi Jagan to the presidency at last.

title: Oil found offshore
description: ExxonMobil announces a major oil find in the Liza well, the start of a petroleum boom that transforms the economy.
